# Upstream source

`wade/` is an unmodified snapshot of Andrew James Wade's MIT-0 licensed
`turing_machine_explorer`. Its original README is intentionally preserved,
including the stale 410-state prose. The pinned example and table have 393 states.

See [provenance and hashes](../reference/upstream.json), the
[license](wade/LICENSE), and our [survey](../docs/SURVEY.md). Local changes belong
in `tools/`, not in this reference snapshot.
